name: erp_vendor_bill_create
description: Enter a vendor bill; new bills are open and route as pendingApproval (POST /services/rest/record/v1/vendorBill)

entity.description: Vendor (entity) internal id the bill is payable to, e.g. vendor_001.

subsidiary.description: Subsidiary internal id the transaction posts to (subsidiary, e.g. '3').

currency.description: Transaction currency internal id (currency): usd, eur or gbp.

amount.description: Bill amount in the transaction currency (userTotal).
